title: Pronunciation practice: everyday sentences
description: Practice pronouncing sentences from lessons 1-9 (greetings, introducing yourself, at the restaurant, directions). Listen to the sentence, look at it, then say it yourself - no new vocabulary, just a new skill: speaking instead of only recognizing.

steps.title: Listen, look, speak
steps.body:
# Listen, look, speak

You already know these sentences from lessons 1-9 - this lesson isn't about recognizing them again. Instead, listen to each sentence, look at it if you need to, and record yourself saying it.

This exercise is not graded - there is no right or wrong answer here. Just compare your recording to the original and hear how close you already are.
